data.gender_notes: Dan is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Dan is recorded in name-lists as “God is my judge”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dan expresses “God is my judge”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dan total 10, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: דָּן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דָּן הוא שם עברי שמשמעו שפט אלוהים, הוא אחד מבניו של יעקב ומייסד שבט דן, שמו מוזכר בספר בראשית

in_greek.name: Δάν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δάν είναι εβραϊκή λέξη που σημαίνει κρίσις Θεού, αναφέρεται στον Δάν, έναν από τους γιους του Ιακώβ και ιδρυτή της φυλής του Δάν, αναφέρεται στο Βιβλίο της Γένεσης

in_latin.name: Dan
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dan est verbum Hebraicum quod significat Dei iudicium, refertur ad Dan, unum ex filiis Iacob et conditorem tribus Dan, refertur in Libro Genesis
